title: ControlLogix
summary: Chassis-based Logix controllers (1756) for large machines and process applications.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: ControlLogix controllers and I/O modules share a chassis backplane; modules can be inserted under power. Several controllers can share one chassis.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: PLC Lab uses this profile to present addresses, analog raw values and product names in the style of the platform. The PLC itself is always PLC Lab's single generic IEC 61131-3 runtime; programs are written in PLC Lab Structured Text, not in the vendor's dialect. **SIMULATION APPROXIMATION**: details such as exact diagnostic texts, timing and module parameters differ from the real product.

modeled: Cyclic scan with input image, transactional program execution and output update
Configured versus installed modules, module status LEDs and diagnostic buffer events
Digital and analog channel behavior including wire break and over/underrange
approximated: Analog channels deliver REAL engineering units (mA or V)
omitted: Vendor firmware, memory model, task model and instruction set
Online editing, retentive memory and multiple tasks
